recipe.appearance_status: Generic KiCad Kemet X-case model scaled in all three dimensions to the TAJ E nominal envelope; yellow body, stripe, shape and metal finish are illustrative. Stripe indicates the positive anode. Marking is composited from shared material passes; indirect reflections are approximate.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
